events.name: R&B ONLY LIVE - Allentown, PA
events.description:
21+

R&B ONLY LIVE is coming to your city for the ultimate R&B experience. Come sing, dance, and experience R&B music from past to present!

Pics and videos from R&B ONLY LIVE:
📱 instagram.com/rnbonly
📱 tiktok.com/@rnbonly

Q: What is R&B ONLY LIVE?
A: R&B ONLY LIVE is a live music experience produced by COLORS Worldwide, dedicated to celebrating R&B music from past to present. It’s a DJ-driven event where audiences can sing, dance, and enjoy a nostalgic journey through R&B music’s greatest hits and modern favorites.

Q: What can I expect at an R&B ONLY LIVE show?
A: R&B ONLY LIVE is a high-energy event designed for fans to connect with R&B music. Our DJ-led show takes audiences on a musical journey through classic and contemporary R&B hits in an atmosphere full of singing, dancing, and R&B nostalgia.

Q: What’s the dress code?
A: There is no specific dress code, but we encourage fans to come ready for a night of dancing and fun! Whether you prefer casual or dressed-up, come as you are and enjoy the experience.

Q: What’s the ticketing policy?
A: All tickets for R&B ONLY LIVE events are non-refundable. If you have questions about your ticket or need it resent, please contact us at info@colorsworldwide.com.

Q: What should I know before attending the show?
A: A valid ID is required for entry at age-restricted shows. We also encourage attendees to check the venue’s bag policy and parking information in advance, as these are determined by the venue and may vary.

Q: How can I stay updated on future shows?
A: Follow us on social media—Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Facebook—for the latest updates, event announcements, and exclusive content. You can also join our mailing list on our website to be among the first to know about new shows and ticket releases.

LEGAL: Must be 21+ to attend. As a condition of your attendance at "R&B ONLY LIVE", you agree and irrevocably consent to your image and/or likeness being captured on film and or video, the benefit of which shall vest in COLORS WORLDWIDE INC., its licensees, successors and assigns, and may be distributed throughout the world in perpetuity, without limitation. All sales are final. With RSVP and/or ticket purchase, you agree to receive communications from COLORS WORLDWIDE INC.

events.name: Comedy 4 Cancer
events.description:
Come laugh. It helps.
Comedy 4 Cancer is a live stand-up comedy event benefiting the American Cancer Society, bringing together some of the Lehigh Valley’s funniest comics, live music, and an internationally acclaimed headliner — America’s Got Talent Golden Buzzer recipient and Top 5 finalist Learnmore Jonasi.
This show is inspired by my mom, who has been dealing with non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma for the past seven years while somehow remaining the loudest and most positive person in every room she walks into.
Including chemo waiting rooms.
Especially chemo waiting rooms.
Comedy 4 Cancer is for her — and for every family that has had someone they love hear those awful words: You have cancer.
So for one night, we’re going to do what we know how to do.
Laugh.
🚪 Doors & Live Music: 6:00 PM
🎤 Comedy: 8:00 PM
Expect a packed room, great comics, live music, and a night that actually feels fun instead of “charity event fun.”
You know the difference.
A portion of proceeds will benefit the American Cancer Society, helping support cancer research, patient services, and programs for people affected by cancer.
Come out. Bring people. Laugh harder than you planned to.
YOUR TOWN. YOUR COMICS. 🎤
Before Learnmore Jonasi takes the stage, Comedy 4 Cancer is bringing together some of the Lehigh Valley’s own.
These are the comics performing in your clubs, your breweries, your theaters and your hometown — and on December 5, they’re all on one stage.
KATE HUGHES
A longtime Lehigh Valley radio personality, actor, emcee and comedian, Kate Hughes turns relationships, anxiety, adulthood and everyday disasters into brutally honest, sharply funny stories.
If life gets awkward, Kate has probably already written a joke about it.
DOUG McHIZZLE
A lifelong fan of stand-up inspired by the legendary Richard Pryor, Doug McHizzle has spent more than 15 years onstage turning his childhood dream of making people laugh into a reality.
Today, he’s a familiar face throughout the Lehigh Valley comedy scene.
RYAN ROSSELL
Lehigh Valley comedian Ryan Rossell has been making audiences laugh for years.
If Ryan seems like he’s trying a little too hard to make you laugh, just ignore him.
He’s probably been day drinking again.
JOSIAH JAMES
Comedy 4 Cancer producer Josiah James got his start as an original member of Lehigh Valley improv troupe The Associated Mess before moving into stand-up in 2008.
Nearly two decades later, he’s still performing locally — and producing Comedy 4 Cancer in honor of his mom and everyone whose life has been affected by cancer.
Your town. Your comics. One big night.
LIVE MUSIC 🎸
The night starts at 6 PM with live music from:
RICH AND DAVE ARE DEAD
Come early, grab a drink, hear some music and settle in before the comedy begins at 8 PM.
HEADLINER: LEARNMORE JONASI 🔥
Learnmore Jonasi is a Zimbabwean stand-up comedian and actor who has quickly become one of the most exciting voices in comedy.
Known for his high-energy physical comedy, storytelling and hilarious observations about life in Africa and America, Learnmore brings a perspective — and an energy — unlike anyone else onstage.
He received Terry Crews’ Golden Buzzer on America’s Got Talent and went on to finish as a Top 5 finalist in the 2024 season.
Learnmore is also the winner of the 2023 Boston Comedy Festival, the 2023 Jersey City Comedy Festival Audience Choice Award, the Savanna Comics’ Choice Pan African Comic of the Year, and Zimbabwe’s National Arts Merit Award for Outstanding Comedian of the Year.
He has performed in more than 20 countries at theaters, festivals, comedy clubs and on television alongside some of the biggest names in comedy.
And on December 5, he’s coming to Allentown to headline Comedy 4 Cancer.
MAKE A NIGHT OF IT 🏨
Coming in from out of town — or just don’t feel like driving home after the show?
We’ve partnered with The Moxy in Downtown Allentown to offer a special group rate for Comedy 4 Cancer guests.
Even better: The Moxy is located right next door to Archer Music Hall, making it about as convenient as a hotel can possibly get.
Book your stay using our special event rate and enjoy a short walk from the hotel to the venue.
